prima: prima — prime, the canonical hour after dawn, the second office of the day (fem. noun; matines e prima 'matins and prime'; = prima)
faza: faza — toward, in the direction of (preposition, a form of faza/fazia, Latin facie ad; faza los albores 'toward the dawn', i.e. as day was breaking; = hacia; Pidal's text reads faza l[os] albor[es])
suelta: soltar — loosed, ended, finished (past part. fem., agreeing with missa; suelta fo la missa 'the mass was ended, dismissed'; passive ser + participle; = soltada, acabada)
ofrenda: ofrenda — offering, oblation made at mass (fem. noun; ssu ofrenda han fecha 'they have made their offering'; = ofrenda)
nació: nacer — he was born (preterite 3rd sg., spelled -c- here; the same word as naçió; en buen ora nació 'born in a good hour', the poem's formula; = nació)
garçiez: Garçiez — García's son, patronymic 'son of García' (Galind Garçiez, the Cid's Aragonese knight; same as Garçiaz; = García's son, modern Garcés/Garcíaz)
cúnplansse: cumplir + se — let them be filled out, made up to full number (present subjunctive 3rd pl. cúnplan + enclitic se, doubled s; con estos cúnplansse çiento 'with these let a hundred be made up'; jussive; = que se cumplan, se completen)
velmezes: velmez — padded undertunic worn under the mail (masc. pl.; Pidal refers to his p. 105 note; velmezes vestidos 'padded tunics put on'; no modern word, closest gambesón/jubón acolchado)
sufrir: sufrir — to bear, support (infinitive; por sufrir las guarnizones 'to bear the weight of the armor'; = sufrir, soportar)
armiños: armiño — ermine (masc. pl.; sobre las lorigas armiños 'over the mail, ermine (furs)'; = armiños)
presos: prender — tied, made fast (past part. masc. pl., agreeing with cordones; bien presos los cordones 'the cords well tied'; = prendidos, atados)
cordones: cordón — cord, lace (masc. pl.; bien presos los cordones, here the cords that fasten the garments or that hold the beard; = cordones)
dulçes: dulçe — sweet; here of swords, fine, gentle to the hand (adjective pl., both genders; las espadas dulçes e tajadores 'smooth, keen swords'; the exact sense of dulçes is uncertain; = dulces)
derechos: derecho — right, due, just claim (masc. pl.; demandar mios derechos 'to claim my rights'; = derechos)
desobra: desobra — excess, wrong, outrage (fem. noun; Pidal: unknown word, seems 'demasía, desmán'; si desobra buscaren 'if they seek an outrage'; no modern word, closest demasía, agravio)
buscaren: buscar — they shall seek, look for (future subjunctive 3rd pl., after si; si desobra buscaren 'if they go looking for an outrage'; = buscaren, archaic/legal; ordinary modern = buscan/busquen)
tovier: tener — I (he) shall have (future subjunctive 1st/3rd sg., strong stem tov-; do tales çiento tovier 'where I have such a hundred'; = tuviere, archaic future subjunctive)
camas: cama — leg (fem. pl.; Pidal 'piernas'; calças … en sus camas metió 'put hose on his legs'; modern cama means bed; = piernas)
huebra: huebra — work, workmanship, ornament (fem. noun, Latin opera; a grant huebra 'with much fine work'; Pidal 'con muchas labores o adornos'; = obra, labor)
vistió: vestir — he put on, dressed himself in (preterite 3rd sg.; vistió camisa 'put on a shirt'; = vistió)
camisa: camisa — shirt, linen undergarment (fem. noun; = camisa)
puño: puño — wrist, cuff, the end of the sleeve (masc. noun; al puño 'at the cuff'; = puño)
çiclatón: çiclatón — ciclatón, a costly silk or silk-and-gold fabric (masc. noun; Pidal: generally woven with gold; brial primo de çiclatón 'a tunic of fine ciclatón'; no modern word, closest brocado)
bandas: banda — band, strip, border of a garment (fem. pl.; las bandas d' oro 'the gold borders'; Pidal: 'franja' more natural than 'ceñidor'; = franjas, bandas)
viste: vestir — he wears, puts on (present 3rd sg.; siempre la viste 'he always wears it'; = viste)
escarín: escarín — a very fine linen cloth (masc. noun; Pidal: 'tela muy fina de hilo'; un escarín de pro 'of good fine linen'; no modern word)
obrada: obrar — worked, embroidered (past part. fem., agreeing with cofia; con oro es obrada 'it is worked with gold'; passive ser + participle; = labrada, bordada)
contalassen: contalassen — verb of unknown meaning (imperfect subjunctive 3rd pl. in -assen after que; Pidal: 'verbo desconocido', must mean 'tear out' or the like: que nol contalassen los pelos 'lest they (his enemies) pull his hair'; sense inferred from context, uncertain; nol = non + le)
prísola: prender + la — he fastened it, tied it (preterite 3rd sg. priso + enclitic la, stress marked prísola; la barba … prísola con el cordón 'he tied up the beard with the cord'; = la ató, la recogió)
cordón: cordón — cord, lace (masc. sg.; con el cordón 'with the cord'; = cordón)
abrien: aver — they would have (conditional 3rd pl., infinitive + imperfect -ien; abrien que veer 'they would have something to look at'; = habrían; spelled with b)
lla: la — the (fem.; spelled ll after the preceding a, a lla cort for a la cort 'to the court'; an orthographic doubling, = la)
cuerdamientra: cuerdamientra — prudently, sensibly (adverb from cuerda + -mientra, a rare variant of -miente; Pidal notes the form; = cuerdamente)
elos: e + los — and the (conjunction e run together with the article los; elos çiento aderredor 'and the hundred around'; = y los)
levantar: levantar — to rise, to get up (infinitive; nos quiso levantar 'he did not wish to rise'; = levantarse; Pidal's text has no reflexive pronoun after nos = non se)
âlgunos: algunos — some (masc. pl.; the circumflex marks a + algunos run together, 'to some': maguer que âlgunos pesa 'although it grieves some'; = a algunos)
merçedes: merçed — thanks, favor (fem. pl.; dixo muchas merçedes 'he said many thanks', i.e. thanked him warmly; = mercedes, gracias)
torniño: torniño — turned, made on the lathe (adjective; escaño torniño; Pidal 'torneado'; = torneado)
aguisamientos: aguisamiento — outfit, array, equipment (masc. pl., from aguisar 'to prepare'; en sos aguisamientos 'in his equipment, as he is arrayed'; = atavíos, aderezos)
vergüença: vergüença — shame, embarrassment (fem. noun; de vergüença 'for shame'; = vergüenza)

__broaden__.primo: primo — cousin (masc. sg.; primo eres de mis fijas 'you are cousin to my daughters'; = primo) · also primo — fine, excellent, of prime quality (adjective; brial primo de çiclatón 'a fine tunic of ciclatón'; Pidal glosses 'primoroso'; = primoroso)
__broaden__.vestidos: vestido — garment, clothing (masc. pl.; = vestidos) · also vestir — put on, worn (past part. masc. pl.; velmezes vestidos 'padded tunics put on'; = vestidos)
__broaden__.sobrellas: sobre + ellas — upon them (fem. pl.; sobrellas va echar 'he goes to cast himself upon them', i.e. to lay siege; the antecedent of ellas is not clear, perhaps Valencia and its lands; uncertain; cf. sobrella) · also sobre + ellas — on top of them (sobrellas unos çapatos 'over them (the hose) some shoes'; here the antecedent is the hose)
__broaden__.so: so/su — his, her, its (unstressed possessive sg.; so çervicio = su servicio); also seer — I am (1st sg. present; = soy; so ayrado, 'I am in [the king's] ira') · lo so — 'what is his, his own' (neuter article + possessive; lo so puede menguar 'what is his may dwindle') · also so — their (so consejo 'their counsel', so vino 'their wine'; = su) · also so — under, beneath (preposition, Latin sub; so los mantos las espadas 'under the cloaks the swords'; = bajo; also so + los)
__broaden__.ala: ala — interjection, 'ho!, hey!' (calling a person to attention; Pidal '¡ola!'; ¡Ala, Per Vermudoz! 'Ho, Per Vermudoz!'; = ¡hola!, ¡eh!) · also a + la — to the (spelled as one word; Ala puerta de fuera descavalga 'at the outer gate he dismounts'; not the interjection)
__broaden__.presas: prender — taken up, taken (past part. fem. pl.; las armas avién presas 'they had taken up their arms'; = presas) · also presa — fastening, clasp, noun (Pidal 'presilla (?)'; con oro e con plata todas las presas son 'all the fastenings are of gold and silver'; the exact sense is uncertain; = presillas)
__broaden__.posó: posar — he camped (preterite) · also posar — he sat down, took his seat (preterite 3rd sg.; en un escaño … posó 'sat on a bench')
__broaden__.posan: posar — they lodge, settle, encamp (present 3rd pl.; posan las yentes descreidas 'the unbelieving host encamps'; = se alojan, acampan; modern posar 'to rest, to pose') · also posar — they sit down, take their seats (present 3rd pl.; posan aderredor 'sit around')
__broaden__.assí: assí — thus, so (= así) · also assí — so greatly, so much (Pidal 'de tal modo, mucho'; assí envergonçó 'was so abashed') · also assí commo 'as soon as' (Assí commo descavalga 'as soon as he dismounts'; = así como, en cuanto) · also assí … commo — 'as many … as' (assí parientes commo son, Pidal 'tantos parientes cuantos son', 'todos ellos', all the kinsmen there are) · also assí — just as, according as (assí commo lo ha dicho 'just as he has said it'; = tal como)
__broaden__.sazón: sazón — due season, prime condition; de sazón 'in good condition, fit' (palafré de sazón 'a palfrey in prime condition', probably; = sazón) · also sazón — time, season, period (de toda esta sazón 'in all this season'; = tiempo) · also a sazón — in due season, fittingly (e a sazón 'and in good time'; = a su tiempo)
__broaden__.razón: razón — talk, speech, matter (dexad essa razón 'leave off that talk'; esta razón 'this matter'; = razón, here closest asunto, conversación) · also razón — 'word, voice' (en una razón 'with one voice, in agreement'; = razón) · also razón — fecha por razón 'made with good reason, with purpose' (the cap fitted for a purpose); also dezir mi razón 'state my case'
__broaden__.ondra: ondra — honor (= honra) · also ondra — a grant ondra 'with great honor' (adverbial phrase)
__broaden__.sabor: sabor — pleasure, wish; a so sabor 'at his (their) pleasure' · also por sabor de 'out of a wish to please, for the sake of' (por sabor de mio Çid 'to please the Cid') · also por sabor que — 'out of the desire (that)' (por sabor que avía de algún moro matare 'out of the longing I had to kill some Moor') · also aver sabor — to long for, to wish (lo que avía sabor 'what I longed for'; a qui yo ovier sabor 'to whomever I please', Pidal 'quisiere') · also mal sabor — pain, distress (don ellas an mal sabor 'from which they have pain'); sin sabor — 'without pleasure, without mercy' (májanlas tan sin sabor 'they beat them so without mercy'; sense perhaps) · also sabor — a sabor 'with pleasure, at ease' (descavalga a sabor 'dismounts at ease'; = con gusto)
__broaden__.anda: andar — he goes, goes along (present 3rd sg.; = anda) · also Mal Anda — a nickname of one of the Cid's men (Mal Anda, probably 'Bad-walker', uncertain)
__broaden__.mal: mal — harm, hurt, ruin · mal — evil, in the prayer's sense (por end es salvo de mal 'therefore he is saved from evil') · also mal — adverb 'sorely, ill' (por cuer le pesó mal 'it grieved him sorely at heart') · also tener a mal — 'to take amiss' (non lo tenga a mal 'let him not take it amiss') · also mal — evil, bad (adjective, apocopated malo, before a noun; mal galardón 'an evil reward'; = mal) · also Mal Anda — nickname of one of the Cid's men (see anda; uncertain)
__broaden__.que: que — that, who, which; for · also por que — because, since (= porque) · por que — by which, whereby (por que más valdrá 'whereby he will be worth more') · also que — 'so that, lest' introducing purpose/result (que por miedo non dexen nada; por tal lo faze … que no lo ventasse nadi); after después/mientra 'after, while' (después que, mientra que) · also que — than, after a comparative (mas le vienen … que nos le van 'more come to him than leave him') · also que — what (indirect interrogative; dezir vos he que faze 'I shall tell you what he does'; = qué) · also que — how, exclamative before an adverb (Dios, que bien los sirvió! 'God, how well he served them!'; = qué) · also que — what, that which (esto que recabdar quiere 'that which he wishes to bring about'; abrien que veer 'they would have something to see')
